1912
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 17 When all was over in the P.M. Aloysius Mccarthy to serve for 1st time arrived for duty and rang door-bell at 3.45 A.M. His brother John was his guardian. A. Dempsey, Wm Hays, and T. Fagan served almost the whole time. Packages were received after Vesp. and cribs.
Dec. 26 First issue of Parish Monthly arrived To-day by express- owing to snow-storm late for Christmas-day-distributed Sun. 29th.
